selector.description: Node kind selected from the context pattern.

precedes.description: Rule a later sibling node must match.

regex.description: Regular expression matched against node text.

stopBy.description: Boundary for relational matching: neighbor, end, or a matching rule.

expandEnd.description: Optional rule that expands the replacement end boundary.

expandStart.description: Optional rule that expands the replacement start boundary.

template.description: Replacement template applied to each selected match.

AR_fix.description: Replacement text or structured ast-grep fix configuration.

AR_include.description: Globs evaluated beneath path before exclusions.

AR_maxFiles.description: File scan cap; reports partial state.

AR_path.description: Absolute source file or directory path.

AR_snapshot.description: Preview snapshot digest required by apply.

toCase.description: Applied after source capture and before template substitution.

chunkSize.description: View-window size in chunkType units; omitted, a unit-dependent default window applies.

chunkType.description: Sets the units used by offset and chunkSize.

contextBytes.description: UTF-8 bytes before and after each match when contextLines is absent.

contextLines.description: Source lines before and after each match.

endLine.description: Set with startLine and do not precede it.

forceRefresh.description: Bypass the content cache and conditionally re-read the file from GitHub.

fullContent.description: Return the whole-file view when it fits; otherwise follow next.continue.

matchString.description: Literal by default; regex when enabled. Selects from full redacted source and merges overlapping windows before paging.

matchStringCaseSensitive.description: Use case-sensitive matching; false or omitted means case-insensitive. (localSearch instead uses caseMode.)

matchStringIsRegex.description: Treat matchString as regex; false or omitted means literal matching. (localSearch instead selects engines via its regex field.)

minify.description: "none" preserves redacted source; "symbols" returns signatures/headings; "standard" compacts. Matches force none.

offset.description: Zero-based view offset in chunkType units (unlike the 1-based startLine); copy returned continuations.

owner.description: Pair the account or organization login with repo.

path.description: Repository-relative file path; preserve exact case and omit a leading slash.

repo.description: Use the repository slug without an owner prefix.

startLine.description: 1-based; set with endLine for exact-range reads; excludes matchString and fullContent.

cursor.description: Opaque runtime cursor; preserve it unchanged when supplied.

query.description: Validated follow-up input; run unchanged instead of reconstructing pagination fields.

checks.description: Filter by the combined status of pull-request checks.

closed.description: Closed-date filter (same format as created).

comments.description: Comment-count range filter (">5"); not comment content.

concise.description: PR list triage; list mode only.

draft.description: true = only drafts; false = exclude drafts.

keywords.description: ANDed terms matched against the selected pull-request text fields; keep a phrase as one item.

match.description: PR text fields searched by keywords: title, body, comments. ghSearch operation:"code" instead uses match to select file content or paths.

order.description: Use ascending created order for oldest-first archaeology.

owner.description: Repository owner; optional for cross-repo search — the detail branch requires it with repo.

reactions.description: Reaction-count range filter (">10").

repo.description: Repository name; optional for cross-repo search — the detail branch requires it with owner.

review.description: Filter by review disposition or review requirement.

review-requested.description: Filter by a requested reviewer login.

question.description: One classification axis evaluated independently for each resource page.

criteria.description: Optional, complete true/false definitions. Omit the object or provide both keys.

false.description: Evidence or condition that counts as no; null is provider-supported.

true.description: Evidence or condition that counts as yes; null is provider-supported.

instructions.description: Ask one decision-linked judgment and front-load the deciding context from your current analysis (hypothesis, constraint, decision at stake) — the provider sees only state, instructions, and criteria; do not hide a checklist or request free-form analysis.

type.description: Use for one affirmative yes/no proposition. Output is P(yes), not intensity; near 0.5 is unresolved.

criteria.description: Use stable, distinct labels. For scouting include relevant, unrelated, and insufficient so missing evidence is not forced into a substantive class.

instructions.description: Ask one decision-linked judgment and front-load the deciding context from your current analysis (hypothesis, constraint, decision at stake) — the provider sees only state, instructions, and criteria; do not hide a checklist or request free-form analysis.

type.description: Use for distinguishable alternatives. Output includes one selected label per resource page and the full probability distribution.

criteria.description: Order level definitions from lowest to highest; adjacent levels must be distinguishable.

instructions.description: Ask one decision-linked judgment and front-load the deciding context from your current analysis (hypothesis, constraint, decision at stake) — the provider sees only state, instructions, and criteria; do not hide a checklist or request free-form analysis.

resources.description: Each resource is captured once and reused across questions. Use one candidate file/result per resource for per-item classification or rating; for heavy context, attach related micro-questions instead of repeating the same read in root queries[]. Page answers localize only when the capture pages; to locate a region inside a file that fits one capture, submit bounded line-window reads as separate resources sharing one question.

instructions.description: Ask one decision-linked judgment and front-load the deciding context from your current analysis (hypothesis, constraint, decision at stake) — the provider sees only state, instructions, and criteria; do not hide a checklist or request free-form analysis.
